wins: Completed reconnaissance quickly, identifying all available ports within first 50 steps.
Maintained consistent reward accumulation despite no successful exploit completion.
Efficient mentor utilization (15 calls) to recover from dead-ends and refocus actions.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges or achieve objective, leading to 0% success rate.
Repeated retracing of steps in exploitation phase caused wasted actions and delayed progress.
Insufficient follow-up on revealed vulnerabilities before switching contexts.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but exploitation actions lacked follow-through and coordination, preventing episode success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Switching targets immediately after finding an open service instead of executing exploit workflow
Opening mentor calls before actionable data is collected, leading to lost momentum

skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to gather host-specific fingerprints

skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute-force with gobuster and log discovered endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When vulnerabilities are listed but no exploits executed
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize version-specific exploit research before switching targets
